name: South Africa

portals.name: Property24
portals.notes: Largest portal. Search pages are readable; detail pages intermittently return server errors to automated readers while still live (treat as unverified, retry). Price-filter query strings tend to error: read unfiltered pages and filter by hand.
portals.searchUrl: https://www.property24.com/{houses|townhouses|apartments}-to-rent/{suburb-slug}/{city-slug}/{province-slug}/{suburbId}  (for-sale: -for-sale-; find suburbId from the site's own suburb pages)
portals.delisted: HTTP 404 with 'no longer available on Property24' (title and photo may still show)

portals.name: Private Property
portals.notes: Second portal and the only home of many private-landlord ('Listed privately') listings. Archived listings return HTTP 200 and redirect to the suburb search with ?archiveId=…: check the final URL still contains the listing id.
portals.detailPattern: …/RR{number} (rentals); any slug before the id redirects to the canonical URL

portals.name: MyProperty
portals.notes: Carries some stock not on the two big portals. Off-market listings show 'off the market'.

portals.name: property.mg.co.za
portals.notes: Mirror of Property24 listings with the same listing ids. Useful when a Property24 search page errors.

portals.name: Gumtree
portals.notes: Blocks cloud sandboxes; readable from the user's own machine or browser. Mostly flats and rooms.

portals.name: Facebook groups and Marketplace
portals.notes: Needs a login and isn't indexed. Ask the user to paste finds.

affordability.rent: Landlords and agents usually want gross household income of at least 3× the rent, plus a credit check (e.g. TPN). Deposit is typically 1–2 months' rent.
affordability.buy: Banks look at repayment-to-income (often up to ~30% of gross) and credit record; a bond originator can compare banks.

applicationDocs: employment letter or contract for new jobs

upfrontCosts: transfer duty (SARS sliding scale, check the current year's table)

vocabulary.sectional title: unit in a scheme with a body corporate
vocabulary.pet friendly: often means small pets: confirm size

quirks: Portals sometimes file a listing under the wrong suburb (an estate shown under the nearest business node): set facts.realArea.
Cross-posting is heavy: the same unit appears via several agencies with different wording and bay counts.
note: Portal names are a starting point. Access is 'untested' until setup tests it live. Never assume a URL pattern works: find a real search page and confirm.
